test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Tall promises were being made by each promoter.

options.text: Each promoter has been making tall promises.
Each promoter has made tall promises.
Each promoter was making tall promises.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Each promoter was making tall promises.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** active voice.**
